name: GE Power India Ltd
title: GE Power India Ltd - 532309 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Order book fell to INR 1,628 cr from INR 2,662 cr as FGD-EP contracts were terminated; core services orders up 32% and FY26 PBT of INR 340 cr is inflated by one-offs (BHEL ECL reversal ~INR 116 cr), with underlying EBITDA ~11%.

triggers.label: Core orders up 32% in FY26
triggers.quote: Core orders, the backbone have risen by 32% from FY24-25

triggers.label: Order book down to INR 1,628 cr
triggers.quote: As of March 31, 2026, your Company has an order backlog of INR 1,628 crores, down from INR 2,662 crores

triggers.label: Durgapur asset-light demerger to JSW
triggers.quote: we are on track for the demerger of Durgapur manufacturing facility to JSW Energy

triggers.label: Underlying FY26 EBITDA ~11% ex one-offs
triggers.quote: excluding the one-offs, your company delivered 11% EBITDA at the entity level in the current financial year

guidance.value: No range given; base 'at par if not more'
guidance.quote: I can't give you a range or something on the guidance for the future in terms of margins

red_flags.label: Related-party cash pool lending INR 450 cr
red_flags.quote: we have deployed INR 450 crores as a loan to some party

red_flags.label: One-off driven PBT
red_flags.quote: reversal of ECL provision for BHEL, which was around INR116 crores

evasions.topic: Deployment of INR 880 cr net cash
evasions.quote: The company is fully aware of the situation and continue to evaluate the effective and the efficient deployment of this for growth.

evasions.topic: Core services market share and expansion
evasions.quote: Our endeavor is to grow that market share, stabilize for the next year or so, and then think of expanding if we have to in other areas.
